Definition: Kadmiel, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Kadmiel is a Levite who comes home from exile: his sons are counted among the Levites who returned, he stands with Jeshua to set forward the workmen in the house of God. He stands on the stairs with the Levites to bless the LORD for ever and ever.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Levites who came back are the quiet backbone of the return, and Kadmiel's name on those lists is his honour.
